svg.title: Green Relief with Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid screen colours. Observed green relief over blue rectangular panel. Overlap follows the photographed curved edge; depth, cast shadow, and perspective omitted.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/green-relief-blue; object B-KELLY-2P12.04; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
